title: Cisco Switch Security Hardening Best Practices
summary: Implement enterprise switchport hardening: mitigate VLAN hopping by changing the native VLAN, disable DTP negotiation, shut down unused ports in a parking-lot VLAN, and enable STP PortFast and BPDU Guard.
learning_objectives: Disable Dynamic Trunking Protocol (DTP) negotiation using switchport nonegotiate
Change the 802.1Q default native VLAN away from VLAN 1 to mitigate double-tagging VLAN hopping attacks
Quarantine and administratively disable all unused switchports into an unrouted blackhole VLAN
Enable Spanning Tree PortFast and BPDU Guard on user access ports to protect topology convergence

source.origin: Independently authored switch security hardening guide replacing legacy fragmented notes
